title: columnmapping
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, importmapid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby.

columnmappingid.description: Unique identifier of the column mapping.

columnmappingidunique.description: Unique identifier of the Column Mapping.

createdon.description: Date and time when the column mapping was created.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the component is introduced.

ismanaged.description: Information that specifies whether this component is managed.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the column mapping was last modified.

processcode.description: Information about whether the column mapping needs to be processed.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the column mapping.

targetattributename.description: Name of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 attribute.

targetentityname.description: Name of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 entity.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the column mapping.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the columnmapping.

_importmapid_value.description: Unique identifier of the associated data map.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the column mapping.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the columnmapping.
